verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled/orchestrated pipeline runs via Apache Airflow plus pipeline monitoring/alerts, which lets ELT jobs run autonomously in the background without manual triggering. However, this relies on an external orchestrator (Airflow) rather than a native built-in scheduler, and there is no evidence of more advanced autonomous/agentic automation (e.g., conditional triggers, self-healing pipelines) beyond basic scheduling. missing for 10: native scheduler details, evidence of complex autonomous decision-making beyond fixed schedules, independent verification of reliability at scale.
